tei:div.tei:p: )hrīḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol: bdag gis bshams pa'i gha ṇa tsakra 'di: gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro: reg dang chos la sogs pa yi: 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched dang lcam dral gyis: rab gus gdung ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na: thugs dam dbang gis myur du bzhes mdzod la: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: hrīḥ dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug lnga dug gsum tshogs su sbyar ba yi: sbyor dang sgrol ba bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'di: 'dod dgur 'bul lo bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hiḥ hrīḥ byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma yab yum thugs dam bskang : dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las myur mdzad chos skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : khyed rnams thugs dam gnyen po bdag gis bskang :

bdag gi cho ga lhag chad khyed kyi bskongs: g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen dbang zlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hrīḥ dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: ma rig dbang gi lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: khro tshogs yab yum thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsal du gsol: ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bshags pa bya'o// zhes rig 'dzin chen po nus ldan pas gsang ba gcig sgrub kyi bskang bar rta mgrin snying thig las khol du phyungs pa lags so/// /
